name: New Trending Jack Bags women's crossbody bag, synthetic leather, squares RM69
description:
Product Description

Product Material: PU
Color: white, red, pink, khaki
Product Dimensions: upper width 20* lower width 22.5* height 13.5* thickness 6CM.
Package Contents: bag *1
1. Women's bag, simple and stylish design. You can wear all casual, retro and refreshing clothes, making it one of the fashionable and elegant choices for your daily use.
2. New and fashionable texture, good toughness, rich and lasting colors, and will not fade. Carefully selected hardware accessories are shiny, durable and scratch-resistant, and will not fade or oxidize.
3. Capacity internal structure, the combination of fashion and practicality, is very suitable for carrying money, keys, lip gloss, combs, mobile phones, sunglasses, pens and note cards. This small bag helps to free your hands.
4. Suitable for various occasions: office, school, travel, leisure, outings, shopping, parties, celebrations, etc. Let this bag accompany you every day.
5. Gift choice for mother and lover; Parents, daughters and friends buy gifts for Christmas, Valentine's Day, birthday, Mother's Day, New Year and Thanksgiving
